items.title: The Infrastructure of Intelligence: NVIDIA and OpenAI on a Decade of Building Frontier AI
items.summary: Frontier AI breakthroughs are also infrastructure breakthroughs. In this fireside chat, NVIDIA’s Ian Buck and OpenAI’s Sachin Katti reflect on a decade of collaboration – from the first DGX-1 to the NVIDIA infrastructure powering Astra – and what they’ve learned building and operating AI at unprecedented scale. They’ll explore how the relationship has expanded beyond frontier model training, how NVIDIA is using OpenAI technology internally, and what the next generation of AI infrastructure will require. Moderated by Bloomberg’s Dina Bass.

items.title: BREAKING: Perplexity's 2 Engineers Built a Database That Cuts Amazon DynamoDB Costs by 20%
items.summary: CobbleDB is Perplexity AI's new custom database, built in just two months to slash search latency for web page retrieval. Perplexity developed this system using only two engineers and hundreds of AI agents to handle code review and testing. The resulting database, written in 40,000 lines of Rust, replaces Amazon DynamoDB for specific search operations by leveraging RocksDB and local NVMe storage. It is not designed as a general-purpose solution but rather to optimize parallel request processing for high-speed data fetching. This new database architecture allows for significant performance gains, with median batch read latency dropping from 31.44ms to 5.60ms. Perplexity plans to open-source the project so other search companies can evaluate the cost and speed tradeoffs for their own workloads.
